source_excerpts.text:
5. Returning the holder without hidden opposing pad loads

A zero resultant wrench at a common holder does not establish that its two pads are individually unloaded.

The revised holder has two independently adjustable six-axis pads. The controller estimates their reaction Jacobian from small measured jogs, then applies bounded adjustments. It receives observations and command history, not the simulator’s true reaction matrix.

The final sequence also establishes an observable zero:

Adjust both pads until their observed reactions are small.
Open pad 1 while pad 2 remains attached and damped.
Verify an actual gap and measure pad 1’s free sensor bias.
Regrip pad 1.
Repeat for pad 2.
Null both using these locally observed corrections.
Open pad 1, re-null pad 2 alone, then open pad 2.

This adds four detachments and two reattachments. It is not represented by a single “release support” command.

The executed controller test covered 168 FE states/load samples:

All converged within the introduced model.
Maximum duration: 44.34 s.
Maximum updates: 49.
Maximum pad travel: 5.74 mm and 3.48 mrad.
Largest evaluated last-pad resultant before opening: 4.253 N and 0.0297 Nm.

The evaluated true values are recorded after the decision; they are not controller inputs.

The hardware consequence

Two conventional 300 mm platforms do not fit in the original narrow holder. The revised arrangement puts them above the frame, with two 700 mm-long, 100 × 100 × 8 mm steel fingers descending to the gripping patches.

This produces:

Lower holder width: 460 mm.
Upper platform width: 660 mm.
Finger mass: 32.35 kg per pair.
Required gross holder lift: at least 6 kN.
Raised holder rail: 3.90 m.
Main bridge underside: 4.20 m.

The stage screen uses obtainable 10 kN screw-jack cores, but their force rating is not sufficient evidence. Across 729 pose samples, the model requires 6.247 kN per leg, 68.1 mm travel and about 95.4 MN/m installed leg stiffness.

The staggered gearbox, motor and brake packing remains unclosed. The nearest base pivots are about 40 mm apart. Six catalogue bodies cannot simply be placed in one plane. This is an unresolved manufactured mechanism, not a free compact stage.

title: Do not infer individual unloaded pads from zero total wrench
